steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic configurations including app name and unique package namespace properties.

steps.title: Configure build.gradle and Environment settings
steps.description: Establish pure Android SDK parameters, target SDK level 34, and strict Java 8 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Setup Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml, declare standard application nodes, MainActivity, permissions, and native alarm receiver.

steps.title: Design Card and Component Styles
steps.description: Write custom drawable XML shapes for background cards, dynamic borders, circular badges, and round button outlines without using AppCompat libraries.

steps.title: Create Database Schema for Data Storage
steps.description: Develop standard SQLiteDatabase wrapper to model and persist Subjects, study Tasks, and future Schedule Reminders.

steps.title: Write local Alarm Notifications Broadcaster
steps.description: Construct custom BroadcastReceiver with notification channels support to trigger instant native task notifications.

steps.title: Design App Main Layout XML
steps.description: Build cohesive multi-view architecture in activity_main.xml featuring modern header, content frame switcher, custom dashboard layout, and tab buttons.

steps.title: Develop Main Planner Application Controller
steps.description: Write Java 8 MainActivity containing logic to register click handlers, custom list-adapters, database transactions, dialog handlers, and custom visual graphics.

steps.title: Perform Clean Build of Student Study Planner
steps.description: Process gradle packaging tasks to assemble fully functional debug APK with dynamic stats reporting and notification engines.
